dashboardQueries.query:
$conn.metadata.vendor_name = "Corelight"
$conn.metadata.product_event_type = "conn" OR $conn.metadata.product_event_type = "conn_red" OR $conn.metadata.product_event_type = "conn_agg"
$conn.observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
$conn.about.application in %corelight_ai_apps
$conn.metadata.ingestion_labels["uid"] = $uid

$anomaly.metadata.vendor_name = "Corelight"
$anomaly.metadata.product_event_type = "anomaly"
$anomaly.observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
$anomaly.network.session_id = $uid
$score = cast.as_int(cast.as_float($anomaly.security_result.detection_fields["item_score"])*100)
match:
    $uid
outcome:
    $app = array_distinct($conn.about.application)
    $total_bytes_kb = array_distinct(math.round(($conn.network.sent_bytes + $conn.network.received_bytes)/1024, 2))
    $item_score = max($score/100)
    $use_case_description = array_distinct($anomaly.security_result.description)
    $orig_h = array_distinct($conn.principal.ip)
    $event_time = array_distinct(timestamp.get_timestamp($conn.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds))
    $time = max($conn.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
order:
    $time, $item_score asc
limit:
    10000
